tickets.title: Prepare charitable funding comparison by December 12, 2025

tickets.title: Resolve Moonbadger Arts Foundation portal and contact problem by December 8, 2025
tickets.text: Resolve the Moonbadger Arts Foundation portal login failure and confirm a contact for securities delivery instructions after the phone callback was routed to general voicemail.
tickets.evidence: Nia reported that the Moonbadger Arts Foundation portal failed during login and that the phone callback for securities delivery instructions was routed to a general voicemail, leaving no confirmed contact for transfer logistics.

tickets.title: Obtain complete cost basis and holding-period evidence for employer shares by December 10, 2025

tickets.title: Reconcile custodian value difference for proposed gift shares by December 11, 2025
tickets.text: Reconcile the market value difference between Nia's spreadsheet and the latest Paper Otter Brokerage quote for the lot earmarked for charity to determine the correct share count for her intended gift amount.
tickets.evidence: Nia’s spreadsheet showed a larger market value for the lot earmarked for charity than the latest Paper Otter Brokerage quote, creating uncertainty about how many shares would meet her intended gift amount; this remains open for December 11, 2025.

tickets.title: Prepare tax projection around charitable deduction capacity by December 17, 2025

tickets.evidence: They agreed to prepare that projection by December 17, 2025.

tickets.title: Update household profile and planning contacts by December 19, 2025
